title: Three Afternoons and One Short Rock
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：lion　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the keeper ① fed the lion that no visitor in the reserve would have recorded, and he said the feeding was the whole of the afternoon. The ② lion, meaning the cat itself and not the rock, ran three afternoons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lion, he said, is the only thing in a reserve that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lion in that reserve had the same short rock beside it, and the ④ lion at the far pool, meaning the roar they kept for the children to imitate and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three afternoons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lion was the whole of the matter, meaning the courage and not the cat. The ⑥ lion, meaning the courage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lion, he said, is either something you feed or the only word that means both a cat and a courage. He said the courage is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ lion had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short rock. The ⑧ lion of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in August, was one reserve and three afternoons of recording; lion, he said, is either the roar at the far pool or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lion I remember is the cat recorded in the journal, which closed in 1989 and is still recorded as the quietest in the reserve. A ⑩ lion, my mother said in 1991, is the only cat that improves by being recorded; every lion, she said, is a courage that has agreed to look like a cat. She said the courage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 狮子；雄狮（指保护区里每一头旁边的那一头）
B. n. 狮子；雄狮（指那头狮子本身，与岩石相对）
C. 固定搭配：feed the lion 喂这头狮子
D. n. 狮子；雄狮（指留给孩子们学着叫的那一声那一头）
E. n. 百兽之事（抽象总称，指一处保护区的狮子之事）
F. n. 狮子；雄狮（指观察日志里写到、被记载的的那一头）
G. n. 勇猛、威风（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 威风（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fed the lion that no visitor in the reserve would have recorded
The lion, meaning the cat itself and not the rock
the lion at the far pool
the lion was the whole of the matter
the lion had become a line in a journal
The lion of the whole thing
A lion, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: feed the lion 意为“喂这头狮子”，1982 年那位饲养员把保护区里没有一位游客肯记载的一头狮子做了一遍。
lion 意为“狮子；雄狮”，指那头狮子本身而不是岩石，它经过了三个午后而在簿子上没有被记载。
lion 意为“狮子；雄狮”，指保护区里每一头旁边的那一头，每一头旁边都有同一块低低的岩石。
lion 意为“狮子；雄狮”，指最远那个水塘留给孩子们学着叫的那一声那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lion 意为“勇猛、威风”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份勇猛就是那件事的全部。
lion 意为“威风”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那头狮子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lion 意为“狮子；雄狮”，指观察日志里写到、被记载的的那一头，到 1987 年这一头成了观察日志里的一行。
lion 意为“百兽之事”，饲养员八月写道，整件事的狮子之事是一处保护区和三个午后的记载。
lion 意为“狮子；雄狮”，我记得的是观察日志里记载过的那一头，1989 年喂完了，至今仍被说成保护区里最安静的一头。
lion 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，狮子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的狮子。
